claims.value: Lantern Slide (black and white); view of Rano Raraku quarry from a distance; moai statue road in the foreground, with teo groups of fallen moai (figure carvings) each; Easter Island.

images.alt: Black-and-white distant view of Rano Raraku quarry, with a statue road and fallen moai in the foreground.

notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a lantern slide attributed to Katherine Maria Routledge, photographed in 1914–1915. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact. The museum's image page identifies this documentary representation, states image-specific CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms and supplies the required credit. The original JPEG was downloaded, visually reviewed against the catalogue description and preserved unchanged. The claim preserves the museum's complete Description wording, including its apparent typo ‘teo groups’. The longer curator's overview is not extracted.
